$comment: Single source for the YPY names: attributes, elements, events, headers, ypy.config keys and CSS classes of the core. Extensions add theirs in src/attributes.d/<extension>.json. 'ypy gen' turns this into the VS Code and JetBrains data and the config JSON schema; 'ypy gen --check' fails when they drift, or when src/ypy.d.ts disagrees. Format: https://ypy.dev/docs/reference/editors.

elements.name: ypy-partial
elements.description: Routes a piece of a response to its own target. Use `ypy-target` or `id` to choose the destination and `ypy-swap` to choose the swap style.

attributes.name: ypy-get
attributes.description: Issues a `GET` request to the URL and swaps the response into the DOM.

attributes.name: ypy-post
attributes.description: Issues a `POST` request to the URL and swaps the response into the DOM.

attributes.name: ypy-put
attributes.description: Issues a `PUT` request to the URL and swaps the response into the DOM.

attributes.name: ypy-patch
attributes.description: Issues a `PATCH` request to the URL and swaps the response into the DOM.

attributes.name: ypy-delete
attributes.description: Issues a `DELETE` request to the URL and swaps the response into the DOM.

attributes.name: ypy-query
attributes.description: Issues a `QUERY` request to the URL and swaps the response into the DOM.

attributes.name: ypy-action
attributes.description: Sets the request URL when the method comes from `ypy-method`.

attributes.name: ypy-method
attributes.description: Sets the HTTP method, paired with `ypy-action`.

values.name: get
values.description: Issue a GET request.

values.name: post
values.description: Issue a POST request.

values.name: put
values.description: Issue a PUT request.

values.name: patch
values.description: Issue a PATCH request.

values.name: delete
values.description: Issue a DELETE request.

values.name: query
values.description: Issue a QUERY request.

attributes.name: ypy-trigger
attributes.description: Chooses which events start the request of the element. Takes a comma separated list of event specifications, each with optional filters and modifiers. Without it, inputs and selects trigger on `change`, forms on `submit` and everything else on `click`.

modifiers.name: once
modifiers.description: Fires only once.

modifiers.name: changed
modifiers.description: Fires only when the value of the element changed.

modifiers.name: delay:<time>
modifiers.description: Debounces: a new event resets the countdown.

modifiers.name: throttle:<time>
modifiers.description: The first event fires at once, later events wait for the cooldown.

modifiers.name: from:<selector>
modifiers.description: Listens on another element. Accepts `document`, `window`, `body`, `closest`, `find`, `next`, `previous`, `self` and `outside`.

modifiers.name: target:<selector>
modifiers.description: Fires only when `event.target` matches the selector.

modifiers.name: prevent
modifiers.description: Calls `event.preventDefault()`.

modifiers.name: stop
modifiers.description: Calls `event.stopPropagation()`. `consume` is a synonym.

modifiers.name: halt
modifiers.description: Shorthand for `prevent stop`.

modifiers.name: capture
modifiers.description: Listens in the capture phase.

modifiers.name: passive
modifiers.description: Tells the browser the listener will not call `preventDefault()`.

modifiers.name: root:<selector>
modifiers.description: With `intersect`: the observer root.

modifiers.name: threshold:<number>
modifiers.description: With `intersect`: the visible fraction that fires, from 0 to 1.

values.name: load
values.description: Fires when the element is loaded.

values.name: revealed
values.description: Fires when the element scrolls into the viewport.

values.name: intersect
values.description: Fires when the element intersects the viewport. Takes `root:<selector>` and `threshold:<number>`.

values.name: every <time>
values.description: Polls at an interval, for example `every 2s`.

attributes.name: ypy-swap
attributes.description: Chooses how the response is inserted into the target. Styles: `innerHTML`, `outerHTML`, `textContent`, `beforebegin`, `afterbegin`, `beforeend`, `afterend`, `innerMorph`, `outerMorph`, `outerSync`, `delete`, `none`, and the styles that extensions add (`download`, `upsert`). Modifiers follow the style.

values.name: innerHTML
values.description: Replaces the inner HTML of the target.

values.name: outerHTML
values.description: Replaces the target element.

values.name: outerSync
values.description: Morphs the attributes of the target, then replaces its children. The target stays in the DOM.

values.name: innerMorph
values.description: Morphs the children of the target, keeping DOM state such as focus and open details. The default.

values.name: outerMorph
values.description: Morphs the target itself, keeping DOM state.

values.name: textContent
values.description: Replaces the text of the target. The response is not parsed as HTML.

values.name: beforebegin
values.description: Inserts before the target. `before` is a synonym.

values.name: afterbegin
values.description: Inserts before the first child of the target. `prepend` is a synonym.

values.name: beforeend
values.description: Inserts after the last child of the target. `append` is a synonym.

values.name: afterend
values.description: Inserts after the target. `after` is a synonym.

values.name: delete
values.description: Deletes the target whatever the response holds.

values.name: none
values.description: Does not swap. Out-of-band swaps and headers still run.

modifiers.name: swap:<time>
modifiers.description: Delay before the swap.

modifiers.name: settle:<time>
modifiers.description: Delay between the swap and the settle.

modifiers.name: transition:true
modifiers.description: Uses the View Transitions API for this swap.

modifiers.name: ignoreTitle:true
modifiers.description: Does not update the document title from the response.

modifiers.name: scroll:top|bottom
modifiers.description: Scrolls the target after the swap.

modifiers.name: show:top|bottom
modifiers.description: Scrolls the target into the viewport.

modifiers.name: scrollTarget:<selector>
modifiers.description: Scrolls this element instead of the target.

modifiers.name: showTarget:<selector>
modifiers.description: Scrolls this element into view instead of the target.

modifiers.name: strip:true
modifiers.description: Removes the outer wrapper element before swapping.

modifiers.name: focusScroll:true
modifiers.description: Scrolls to the focused element.

modifiers.name: swapEmpty:true
modifiers.description: Runs the main swap even when nothing remains after the out-of-band and partial content is removed.

modifiers.name: target:<selector>
modifiers.description: Retargets the swap.

attributes.name: ypy-target
attributes.description: Sets where the response is inserted. Takes a CSS selector, `this`, or an extended selector: `closest <selector>`, `find <selector>`, `next [selector]`, `previous [selector]`. Defaults to the element itself.

attributes.name: ypy-select
attributes.description: Picks the part of the response to swap into the target, by CSS selector.

attributes.name: ypy-select-oob
attributes.description: Picks elements of the response by selector and swaps each one out of band, by `id`. Takes a comma separated list of `<selector>[:<swap>]`.

attributes.name: ypy-swap-oob
attributes.description: Marks an element of the response to be swapped out of band into the element with its `id`. The value is `true`, a swap style, or `<style>:<selector>` to pick the target.

values.name: true
values.description: Swap into the element with the same `id`, with the default out-of-band style.

attributes.name: ypy-on
attributes.description: Runs inline JavaScript when an event fires. Write `ypy-on:<event>` for any DOM event, or `ypy-on::<event>` as shorthand for `ypy-on:ypy:<event>`. Code runs only when `config.callbacks` allows it.

attributes.name: ypy-vals
attributes.description: Adds values to the request parameters. Takes JSON or HCON, or a JavaScript expression with the `js:` prefix.

attributes.name: ypy-include
attributes.description: Includes the values of other elements in the request. Takes a selector, `this`, or an extended selector.

attributes.name: ypy-headers
attributes.description: Adds request headers. Takes JSON or HCON, or a JavaScript expression with the `js:` prefix.

attributes.name: ypy-encoding
attributes.description: Sets the request encoding. Use `multipart/form-data` for file uploads.

values.name: multipart/form-data
values.description: Sends the form as multipart, needed for file inputs.

attributes.name: ypy-config
attributes.description: Sets fetch options of the request of the element (`timeout`, `credentials`, `cache`, and so on). It cannot override `mode`.

attributes.name: ypy-indicator
attributes.description: Names the elements that receive the `ypy-request` class while the request runs. Takes a selector or an extended selector.

attributes.name: ypy-boost
attributes.description: Turns links and forms inside the element into YPY requests that swap the body and push the URL. Set it to `false` to opt a subtree out.

attributes.name: ypy-sync
attributes.description: Decides what happens when the element asks for a request while another from the same owner is in flight. The value is `[<selector>:]<strategy>`, with `queue first` as the default.

values.name: drop
values.description: Refuses the new request.

values.name: abort
values.description: Refuses the new request. A request started with `abort` is itself aborted by any other kind of request.

values.name: replace
values.description: Aborts the request in flight, discards the waiting ones and runs the new one.

values.name: queue first
values.description: The new request waits, unless one is already waiting, then it is refused. The default.

values.name: queue last
values.description: The new request waits and replaces the one that was waiting.

values.name: queue all
values.description: The new request waits behind all the others.

values.name: latest
values.description: The new request runs at once and the older ones are not aborted, but their responses are discarded when they arrive (`ctx.superseded`): the newest request wins, whatever the order of arrival.

values.name: parallel
values.description: No queue: the request runs at once, waits for none and aborts none. An older response still never overwrites a newer one on the same target.

attributes.name: ypy-confirm
attributes.description: Asks for confirmation before the request. The value is the message; `js:` runs an expression that may return a promise. The `ypy:confirm` event can replace the dialog.

attributes.name: ypy-validate
attributes.description: Validates with the browser constraint API before the request: the form, the element and the elements `ypy-include` adds. On by default for a form without `novalidate`; set it to `true` for other elements or to `false` to turn it off. On a field, with the `ypy-validate` extension, any other value (or none) is a URL: the field is checked on the server when the user leaves it.

attributes.name: ypy-ignore
attributes.description: Stops YPY from processing the element and its children.

attributes.name: ypy-push-url
attributes.description: Pushes a URL into the browser history once the swap was applied; a swap that failed pushes nothing. `true` uses the request URL, `false` suppresses the push of a boosted request. A boosted request pushes by default only when it is a GET or was redirected to a page: a POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE answered with a page needs this attribute.

values.name: true
values.description: Pushes the URL of the request.

values.name: false
values.description: Pushes nothing.

attributes.name: ypy-replace-url
attributes.description: Replaces the current history entry after the swap. `true` uses the request URL.

values.name: true
values.description: Replaces with the URL of the request.

values.name: false
values.description: Replaces nothing.

attributes.name: ypy-history-elt
attributes.description: Marks the element that is restored when the user navigates through the history, instead of `body`.

attributes.name: ypy-status:*
attributes.description: Changes how a response with one status code, or a range such as `5xx` or `50x`, is handled. The value sets `swap:`, `target:`, `select:`, `push:`, `replace:` or `transition:`.

attributes.name: ypy-error-target
attributes.description: Sets where a response of status 400 or more is swapped. Takes the same selectors as `ypy-target`. Without it, a 422 goes into the form of the source element.

attributes.name: ypy-error-swap
attributes.description: Sets the swap style of a response of status 400 or more. Takes a swap spec as in `ypy-swap`.

attributes.name: ypy-error-focus
attributes.description: Says where the focus goes after an error response is swapped: `first-invalid`, a selector, or `false`.

values.name: first-invalid
values.description: The first field marked `aria-invalid="true"`, or the first invalid field.

values.name: false
values.description: Does not move the focus.

attributes.name: ypy-main
attributes.description: Marks the main target: the element a swap falls back to when its target selector matches nothing. Without a marker, `<main>` is the main target.

attributes.name: ypy-fallback
attributes.description: Overrides `config.targetFallback` for the element: whether a missing target falls back to the main target.

values.name: true
values.description: Falls back when the response is a whole page or holds a main.

values.name: always
values.description: Falls back for a fragment too.

values.name: false
values.description: Never falls back.

attributes.name: ypy-focus
attributes.description: Says where the keyboard focus goes when a swap ends. After a boosted navigation it moves to the heading of the new page. On an `[autofocus]` element of swapped content, any value makes the swap focus it (the core does not otherwise).

values.name: auto
values.description: After a boosted request, the first `h1` of `[ypy-main]` (else `<main>`, else the swap target), with a temporary `tabindex="-1"`. The title is not announced a second time. Any other request moves nothing.

values.name: none
values.description: Leaves the focus where the swap left it.

values.name: first-heading
values.description: The first heading of the swap target.

attributes.name: ypy-scroll
attributes.description: Sets the scroll position when a swap ends: keep it, send it to the top, to an offset, or put a saved position back.

values.name: keep
values.description: The window and the swap target return to where they were just before the swap.

values.name: top
values.description: The window and the swap target scroll to the top.

values.name: restore
values.description: The window goes to the position saved for a history entry.

attributes.name: ypy-announce
attributes.description: Tells screen readers what changed after a request, through a live region YPY manages. The value is the text, `title` for the new document title, or `none`.

values.name: title
values.description: Announces the title of the new document.

values.name: none
values.description: Announces nothing.

attributes.name: ypy-busy
attributes.description: Opts the element, or its target, out of the automatic `aria-busy` mark during a request when set to `false`.

attributes.name: ypy-preserve
attributes.description: Says how much of an element a swap or morph leaves alone. No value keeps the node by `id`; `all`, `attrs`, `children` and `false` refine it. Never inherited.

values.name: true
values.description: Keeps the same DOM node, matched by `id`.

values.name: all
values.description: Keeps the node, its attributes and its children.

values.name: attrs
values.description: The morph does not set, change or remove any attribute. Children merge as usual.

values.name: children
values.description: Attributes follow the response, children are not touched.

values.name: false
values.description: Switches off the default for third-party elements on this element.

values.name: value
values.description: Extension `ypy-preserve`: keeps what the visitor typed or chose in the field and its descendants with an `id`. Words combine with a space: `value selection`.

values.name: selection
values.description: Extension `ypy-preserve`: keeps the caret or the selected text of the field.

values.name: focus
values.description: Extension `ypy-preserve`: gives the focus back to the element if it had it before the swap.

values.name: scroll
values.description: Extension `ypy-preserve`: keeps the scroll position of the element.

attributes.name: ypy-preserve-attrs
attributes.description: Lists the attributes a morph must neither set nor remove. Everything else follows the response. Entries may end with `*`.

attributes.name: ypy-morph-skip
attributes.description: Freezes the element during a morph swap: it is neither updated nor removed.

attributes.name: ypy-morph-skip-children
attributes.description: Updates the attributes of the element during a morph swap but freezes its children.

attributes.name: ypy-morph-force
attributes.description: Set in the response: lets the response win over what the user did to the element in a morph, such as the `open` state of `<details>`, the value of a field that has the focus, the children of a custom element or a mode of `ypy-preserve`.

events.name: ypy:before:process
events.description: Fires before YPY processes a DOM node or subtree. Cancel it to leave the subtree unprocessed.

events.name: ypy:after:process
events.description: Fires after YPY processed a DOM node or subtree.

events.name: ypy:before:init
events.description: Fires before YPY attaches its internal data to an element. Cancel it to leave the element alone.

events.name: ypy:after:init
events.description: Fires after an element has all its YPY behaviors and listeners.

events.name: ypy:before:on:init
events.description: Fires before YPY binds the `ypy-on` attributes of an element. Cancel it to leave them unbound.

events.name: ypy:before:cleanup
events.description: Fires before YPY removes listeners and internal data from an element, on removal during a swap or before reprocessing. It reaches only elements YPY processed, that is, elements with a `ypy-*` or `data-ypy-*` attribute (and their `ypy-on` handlers); an element without one gets no event. To follow the departure of the others, observe the document with a `MutationObserver` and read `removedNodes`.

events.name: ypy:after:cleanup
events.description: Fires after YPY removed the listeners and internal data of an element. Like `ypy:before:cleanup`, it reaches only elements YPY processed (with a `ypy-*` attribute); use a `MutationObserver` for the others.

events.name: ypy:confirm
events.description: Fires when an element with `ypy-confirm` is triggered, before the request. Call `preventDefault()` to replace the dialog, then call `issueRequest()` or `dropRequest()`; the request waits until one is called.

events.name: ypy:config:request
events.description: Fires after the request values are collected and validated, before encoding and sending. Change `ctx.request` to adjust headers, timeout or credentials. Cancel it to stop the request.

events.name: ypy:before:request
events.description: Fires right before `fetch()`, after all configuration. Cancel it to stop the request.

events.name: ypy:before:response
events.description: Fires once the response headers arrive, before the body is read. `ctx.response.raw` is the unconsumed `Response`. Cancel it to skip the body and the swap.

events.name: ypy:after:request
events.description: Fires after the response body was read, before the swap. `ctx.response` holds the status and headers. Cancel it to skip the swap.

events.name: ypy:response:error
events.description: Fires when the server answers with status 400 or more. It does not fire for network errors; use `ypy:error` for those.

events.name: ypy:error
events.description: Fires when an exception ends the request or the swap. It does not fire for HTTP 4xx or 5xx. `ctx` is absent when the error happens before the request context exists.

events.name: ypy:finally:request
events.description: Fires when a request completes, fails or is cancelled. It does not fire when processing stops before the request starts.

events.name: ypy:before:swap
events.description: Fires after the response is parsed and before it is inserted. `tasks` lists the swap tasks. Cancel it to prevent the swap.

events.name: ypy:after:swap
events.description: Fires once per swap, after every task of the response has inserted its content, settled it (`ypy:before:settle` and `ypy:after:settle` fired for each task) and processed it (`ypy:after:process`). The focus, the title and the scroll are applied right after. It fires after `ypy:after:settle`, not before.

events.name: ypy:finally:swap
events.description: Fires at the end of the swap lifecycle, whether it succeeded or failed.

events.name: ypy:before:settle
events.description: Fires after new content is inserted and before CSS transitions are applied. Change `newContent` here.

events.name: ypy:after:settle
events.description: Fires after the settle phase of one task, including every CSS transition, once per swapped target (the main swap, each out-of-band element and each partial). It fires before the new content is processed and before `ypy:after:swap`, which fires once for the whole swap. The DOM is stable.

events.name: ypy:before:viewTransition
events.description: Fires before a View Transition starts, when `config.transitions` is on and the browser supports it. Cancel it to skip the transition for this swap.

events.name: ypy:after:viewTransition
events.description: Fires after a View Transition finished.

events.name: ypy:before:history:update
events.description: Fires before `history.pushState()` or `history.replaceState()`. Cancel it to prevent the history update.

events.name: ypy:after:history:update
events.description: Fires after `history.pushState()` or `history.replaceState()` completed.

events.name: ypy:after:history:push
events.description: Fires after a new history entry was created.

events.name: ypy:after:history:replace
events.description: Fires after the current history entry was replaced.

events.name: ypy:before:history:restore
events.description: Fires when the user navigates back or forward, before the page is restored. Cancel it to restore by hand. Extensions such as `ypy-history-cache` can handle a cache hit.

events.name: ypy:history:restore:fragment
events.description: Fires when a history restore got something that is not a whole page. The page is reloaded right after. Turn the safety net off with `config.historyRestore.fragment`.

events.name: ypy:abort
events.description: Control event: dispatch it on an element to abort its request in flight. YPY listens to it; it does not fire it.

events.name: ypy:request:queued
events.description: A request waits behind the one in flight (`queue first`, `queue last`, `queue all`).

events.name: ypy:request:dropped
events.description: A request that never ran was discarded; `ctx` is that request.

events.name: ypy:request:aborted
events.description: The request in flight was aborted before its response; `ctx` is that request.

events.name: ypy:offline
events.description: The browser went offline: `<html>` carries the offline class. Fires on `document`.

events.name: ypy:online
events.description: The connection came back, or a response proved it. Fires on `document`.

events.name: ypy:announce
events.description: Fires on the source element just before a message goes into the live region. A listener may change `message` and `politeness`, or cancel to say nothing.

events.name: ypy:target:fallback
events.description: The main target selector matched nothing and the chain `[ypy-main]`, `<main>` took over. `selector` is what failed, `used` the fallback selector.

events.name: ypy:target:missing
events.description: No target was found for a main swap, an out-of-band element or a partial. Cancel it to silence the console warning.

events.name: ypy:swap:error
events.description: A swap task failed while the others went on. Fires once per failed task, before `ypy:after:swap`.

events.name: ypy:security:blocked
events.description: Author code (`ypy-on`, a `js:` value or a `[filter]` trigger) was not compiled because of `config.callbacks`, or a redirect or WebSocket URL was refused (`reason` `redirect`, `websocket-origin`).

events.name: ypy:before:oob
events.description: Extension hook (`ypy_before_oob`): runs for each out-of-band element and each partial of a response, before the core takes it out of the response. Return `false` to veto it: an out-of-band element stays ordinary content, a partial is dropped. `ypy-csp` uses it to ignore the ones without the page nonce. Never dispatched on the DOM.

events.name: ypy:scope
events.description: Extension hook: runs before author code is compiled, so an extension can add names to its scope or rewrite `code`. Never dispatched on the DOM.

events.name: ypy:before:morph:node
events.description: Extension hook: runs for each pair of nodes a morph matches. Return `false` to skip the node. Never dispatched on the DOM.

events.name: ypy:before:morph:attr
events.description: Extension hook: runs for each attribute a morph is about to set or remove. Return `false` to keep the attribute as it is. Never dispatched on the DOM.

events.name: ypy:resolve:target
events.description: Extension hook (`ypy_resolve_target(elt, selector)`): runs for every part of a selector (`ypy-target`, `ypy.find()`...) the core does not know, before it falls to `querySelectorAll`. Return an element, an array or a NodeList of them, `null` for no element, or `undefined` when the selector is not yours. `ypy-scope` uses it. Never dispatched on the DOM.

events.name: ypy:dispose
events.description: Extension hook (`ypy_dispose`): runs once when `ypy.dispose()` starts, before anything is taken down, so an extension removes the listeners, timers and observers it installed. Never dispatched on the DOM.

events.name: ypy:process:*
events.description: Extension hook family: `ypy:process:<type>` runs for a `<ypy-partial>` whose `type` is not built in, so an extension can add swap tasks. Never dispatched on the DOM.

headers.name: YPY-Request
headers.description: Always `true` on a YPY request. Servers that vary a page by it should send `Vary: YPY-Request`.

headers.name: YPY-Source
headers.description: The element that triggered the request.

headers.name: YPY-Target
headers.description: The element the response is swapped into.

headers.name: YPY-Current-URL
headers.description: The current URL of the browser.

headers.name: YPY-Request-Type
headers.description: `partial` for a targeted swap, `full` when the target is `body` or `ypy-select` is used.

headers.name: YPY-Boosted
headers.description: Present when the request comes from `ypy-boost`.

headers.name: YPY-History-Restore-Request
headers.description: Present when the request restores a page after back or forward. The server should answer with a whole page.

headers.name: YPY-Trigger
headers.description: Fires client-side events after the response. A single name, a comma separated list, or a JSON object of event names and details.

headers.name: YPY-Push-Url
headers.description: Pushes a URL into the browser history. It overrides the history attributes of the element.

headers.name: YPY-Replace-Url
headers.description: Replaces the current history entry. It overrides the history attributes of the element.

headers.name: YPY-Redirect
headers.description: Redirects the browser with a full page load.

headers.name: YPY-Location
headers.description: Navigates to a URL with an AJAX request, without a full reload. It also takes a JSON object with `path` and request options.
headers.value: a URL or a JSON object

headers.name: YPY-Refresh
headers.description: Reloads the page when the value is `true`.

headers.name: YPY-Retarget
headers.description: Overrides the target of the swap with a CSS selector.

headers.name: YPY-Reswap
headers.description: Overrides the swap style of the response.

headers.name: YPY-Reselect
headers.description: Overrides `ypy-select`: the part of the response that is swapped.

headers.name: YPY-Group
headers.description: Makes the swap all or nothing when the value is `atomic`: if one task of the response (main swap, out-of-band element or partial) has no target, none is applied and the history is not updated. The default applies the tasks that can run.

config.name: logAll
config.description: Logs every YPY event to the console.

config.name: prefix
config.description: Adds one more attribute prefix. `ypy-` and `data-ypy-` always work. Set it in the `ypy-config` meta tag; changing it after load has no effect.

config.name: transitions
config.description: Uses the View Transitions API for swap animations.

config.name: history
config.description: Controls history management: `true` pushes URLs and restores by request, `false` turns history off, `"reload"` pushes URLs and reloads the page on back and forward.

config.name: mode
config.description: The fetch `mode` of every YPY request. Elements cannot override it.

config.name: defaultSwap
config.description: The swap style used when `ypy-swap` is not set: `innerMorph`.

config.name: defaultFocusScroll
config.description: Scrolls the focused element into view after each swap.

config.name: defaultSettleDelay
config.description: Delay in milliseconds between the swap and the settle phases.

config.name: defaultTimeout
config.description: Default request timeout in milliseconds.

config.name: classes
config.description: State classes, one entry per state, each a space separated list. Set an entry to replace it.

config.name: classes.request
config.description: Applied to the indicators of the request while it runs (the requesting element, unless `ypy-indicator` names others). `data-ypy-state="request"` is set with it.

config.name: classes.swapping
config.description: Applied to the swap target between the start of the swap and the swap itself.

config.name: classes.settling
config.description: Applied to the swap target while it settles.

config.name: classes.added
config.description: Applied to freshly swapped content until it settles.

config.name: classes.indicator
config.description: Applied to elements that show only during a request.

config.name: classes.error
config.description: Added to the error target after a response of 400 or more was swapped. There is no default class: `data-ypy-state="error"` is enough to style it.

config.name: classes.offline
config.description: Applied to `<html>` while the browser reports no connection.

config.name: includeIndicatorCSS
config.description: Includes the built-in CSS of the indicator class.

config.name: inlineScriptNonce
config.description: The `nonce` of the inline `<script>` elements YPY creates, for a strict CSP.

config.name: extensions
config.description: Comma separated list of the extensions allowed to register. Empty allows all.

config.name: morphIgnore
config.description: Attribute name prefixes a morph leaves alone.

config.name: morphScanLimit
config.description: How many siblings a morph scans when it matches nodes.

config.name: morphSkip
config.description: Selector of the elements a morph skips entirely.

config.name: morphSkipChildren
config.description: Selector of the elements whose children a morph freezes. Their attributes still update.

config.name: morphThirdParty
config.description: Selector of the elements a script other than YPY owns, besides every custom element. A morph keeps the children of such an element when the response gives it empty, unless it carries `ypy-preserve="false"`. A custom element that is already defined always keeps its children: only the attributes follow the response, unless the response marks it with `ypy-morph-force`.

config.name: autofocus
config.description: Focuses the `[autofocus]` element of swapped content. Off by default; an `[autofocus]` element with `ypy-focus` asks for it by itself.

config.name: noSwap
config.description: HTTP status codes for which YPY does not swap content.

config.name: metaCharacter
config.description: Replaces `:` in attribute modifiers, for templating engines that treat `:` specially.

config.name: allowEmptySwapAfterOOB
config.description: Runs the main swap when the response held only out-of-band elements. `<ypy-partial>` content always prevents the main swap.

config.name: targetFallback
config.description: What happens when a target selector matches nothing: `true` falls back to the main target for a whole page or a response with a main, `"always"` also for a fragment, `false` never. Unset means on.

config.name: ariaBusy
config.description: Marks the target `aria-busy="true"` while a request runs. Unset means on.

config.name: announce
config.description: Announcements through the managed live region. Unset means on; `false` turns them off; an object sets the messages.

config.name: announce.clearAfter
config.description: Milliseconds before the live region is emptied.

config.name: announce.messages
config.description: Texts for the live region. The core carries none: a message that is not set says nothing.

config.name: announce.messages.loading
config.description: Said when a request starts.

config.name: announce.messages.done
config.description: Said when a request ends and its response was swapped.

config.name: announce.messages.offline
config.description: Said when a request failed for lack of a connection.

config.name: announce.messages.error
config.description: Said when a request failed for any other reason.

config.name: callbacks
config.description: What author code (`ypy-on`, `js:` values, `[filter]` triggers) may do: `none` never compiles code, `nonce` runs it only through `ypy-csp`, `all` always runs it. Unset means `none`.

config.name: scripts
config.description: What happens to the `<script>` elements of a response: `auto` lets them run, `nonce` lets run only those with the nonce of the page (`inlineScriptNonce`, else the nonce of the first `<script nonce>`), `block` runs none. The scripts that do not run are taken out of the response. Any other value counts as `block`.

config.name: selfRequestsOnly
config.description: Alias of `mode`: `true` is `same-origin`, `false` is `cors`.

config.name: historyRestore
config.description: Options of the request that restores a page from history.

config.name: historyRestore.cache
config.description: The fetch `cache` mode of the request that restores a page on back and forward. The default is `no-cache`.

config.name: historyRestore.fragment
config.description: Reloads the page when a restore gets something that is not a whole page, instead of swapping the fragment. On by default.

classes.name: ypy-request
classes.description: Applied to the requesting element and to its indicators while a request is in flight.

classes.name: ypy-swapping
classes.description: Applied to a target during the swap delay, then removed when the content is inserted.

classes.name: ypy-settling
classes.description: Applied to a target during the settle phase, then removed after it completes.

classes.name: ypy-added
classes.description: Applied to newly inserted content before it settles, then removed.

classes.name: ypy-indicator
classes.description: Default indicator class, hidden by YPY CSS until a containing or matching element receives `ypy-request`.

classes.name: ypy-offline
classes.description: Applied to `<html>` while the browser reports no connection, together with `data-ypy-state="offline"`.

classes.name: ypy-progress
classes.description: A fixed bar at the top of the page, styled by `ypy.css`: invisible until it is in the `request` state, then it runs. Themed by `--ypy-progress-color`, `--ypy-progress-height`, `--ypy-progress-duration` and `--ypy-progress-z`.

classes.name: ypy-fade
classes.description: Opt-in transition of `ypy.css`: the swap target fades out while it is in the `swapping` state (use a swap delay, for example `swap:200ms`).

classes.name: ypy-fade-in
classes.description: Opt-in transition of `ypy.css`: new content fades in, starting from `@starting-style`.
